shortDescription: Manages an RHSM Cloud Access provider account

options.name: id
options.description: Account ID of the cloud provider account

options.name: nickname
options.description: Nickname or short description of the cloud provider account

options.name: provider
options.description: Short Name of the cloud provider

options.name: refresh_token
options.description: Offline refresh token for authentication with Red Hat APIs Tokens can be generated at https://access.redhat.com/management/api

options.name: refresh_token_client
options.description: Client ID used to generate the refresh token Typically 'rhsm-api' for tokens generated at access.redhat.com and 'cloud-services' for cloud.redhat.com

options.name: state
options.description: Add or remove a cloud provider account

options.name: verification_identity
options.description: Cloud VM instance identity document Only needed to verify a cloud provider account for use with RHSM auto registration

options.name: verification_signature
options.description: Cloud VM instance identity signature Only needed to verify a cloud provider account for use with RHSM auto registration
